title: PRIVATE TOUR BEIJING
route: Tiananmen Square - Forbidden City - Great Wall of China - Summer Palace

includes: 4 Nights Accommodation with daily International Breakfast on sharing basis (*4Star Hotel)
Cable car at Great Wall China
excludes: Private Driver & Guide is base on 10 hours basis. Additional fees will be charged for every extra hour usage
Luggage, In Flight Meal & Airport Tax

itinerary.title: Arrival In Beijing + City Tour
activities: Arrive in Beijing Daxing Intl' Airport (PKX)
Visit Nanluogoxiang (Historic alley famous for its hutongs and traditional heritage houses)

itinerary.title: Great Wall Of China + City Tour
activities: Tiananmen Square (UNESCO Historic Square of Beijing)
Forbidden City (September to June) (Residence of the Chinese Emperor)
Visit Jingshan Park (July-August) (Man-made hill with Forbidden City panoramic view)

itinerary.title: Beijing City + Shopping Tour
activities: Mutianyu Great Wall of China (Incl 2 way Cable Car or Toboggan)
Summer Palace (Chinese palace with Qing Dynasty architecture)
Photostop at Bird Nest (Beijing Olympic Stadium)
Photostop at Water Cube (Olympic Aquatic Centre)

itinerary.title: Muslim Street Tour
activities: Niujie Mosque (Beijing oldest and largest mosque)
Visit Niujie Muslim Market (Shopping & Halal Food)
The Place LED Screen (Futuristic shopping center featuring a massive LED screen ceiling)

itinerary.title: Airport Transfer - Departure Beijing - Kuala Lumpur
activities: Arrive in Kuala Lumpur International Airport (KLIA)

expect.title: Large Crowds
expect.body: Expect large crowds and queues in China, especially during holidays and peak travel seasons.

expect.title: Communication
expect.body: Download WeChat and translation apps for seamless communication.

expect.title: Required Walking
expect.body: Wear comfortable shoes and avoid heels, as they're not ideal for the terrain and activities.

expect.title: Payment
expect.body: Setup E-Wallet payment (Alipay) as some places may prefer cashless payment.

expect.title: Private Transport
expect.body: Private transport will be used for all activity transfers.

expect.title: Distant Drop Off
expect.body: The drop-off point may not be directly at the entrance & require walking.

entries: All prices are valid for 24 hours after quotation submission.
The price is for 2 to 3 persons per room.
Fare is not applicable during peak seasons; please refer to the peak season surcharge.
Late Booking Surcharge of RM50/booking will apply for bookings made less than 45 days before the departure date.
This package is valid until 31st December 2026 travel period.
Private Transportation & Tour Guide is based on 10 hours basis. Additional fees will be charged for every extra hour usage. Payment must be paid in cash.
Quotation, consequence of itinerary and price are subject to change accordingly.
Final itinerary and hotel arrangements will be confirmed at least 15 days before trip.
Please check with our staff on the trip validity or before booking any connecting domestic flights.
Default arrangement might change without prior notice depending on the current weather & traffic condition.

deposit.text: prior to arrival for full payment
